title: The Sap Camp
journal: The note from the reed hide sent the sap-takers' jars to Karsh-Naal Camp, a Naga camp in the marsh east of Teel-Fen Weir. Someone there is caged at the camp's edge. The key to the cage is on a guard named Jeeta-Sakka, who stands at the fire with the others. I can pick the cage's lock, steal the key from him, or fight the guards. I'm to open the cage; once it is open, Sesk wants her sack from the floor inside handed to her.
objectives: Open the cage at Karsh-Naal Camp and take Sesk's sack from inside (a Novice lock, or the key on Jeeta-Sakka). (marker: Sesk's Cage, Jeeta-Sakka, Sesk's Sack)

plan.going: The sap goes to Karsh-Naal Camp, guarded by Naga. Someone is caged there.
plan.next: Open the cage at the camp's west edge and take Sesk's sack from inside it.
plan.ways: Pick its Novice lock; steal the key from Jeeta-Sakka at the fire; or fight the four guards (or shoot them from the reeds). The guards stay at the fire, so I can sneak to the cage.

answers: I am Tarin, a thief freed by Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa, who serves the Toh-Reel-Ka. The Hists are sickening. Unbound Sap-Takers drained a young Hist at Teel-Fen Weir. Their note sent jars of sap to Karsh-Naal Camp, so I followed it. Someone named Sesk is caged at the camp edge.
Open the cage at Karsh-Naal Camp and take Sesk sack from the floor inside, then hand it to her.
Pick the Novice lock on the cage, steal the key from guard Jeeta-Sakka, or fight the guards. Picking or stealing seems quieter than fighting three Naga guards.
I do not know who Sesk is, what is in the sack, or who the Unbound master is. I could ask Sesk or the guards, and look around the camp.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: I opened the cage and have Sesk's sack. I'm to give it to her and hear what she knows.

plan.going: The cage is open and Sesk is free to talk.

answers: I opened the cage and took the sack. Sesk, the prisoner, wants it back and may know about the sap-takers.
Talk to Sesk in the cage and give her the sack.
Hand over the sack and ask questions, or keep it and look inside first, though that seems unfriendly.
I still do not know who Sesk is, what is in the sack, or who leads the Unbound. I can ask Sesk.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Sesk drew sap for the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless whose leader is Cuts-the-Old-Knot. The sap is for a draught, and the draught has something to do with "the Eye". They call the grey paste in the scars "the seal". Why drain a tree and then seal it, if they only want its sap? I'm to take this to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa.
objectives: Tell Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa what Sesk said. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: The Unbound, led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain trees for a draught to do with "the Eye", and seal the scars. The question I carry: why seal a tree they only want sap from?
plan.next: Go back to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her.

answers: Sesk, a Naga, drew sap for the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot. They cut a scar, fill jars, and press grey paste called the seal in. The jars come to this camp and go on to the leader. The sap goes into a draught tied to something called the Eye. Sesk is now free and leaving.
Go to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her what Sesk said.
I can go straight to Vosh-Leera, or first ask Sesk more about Cuts-the-Old-Knot and the seal, or look around the camp, where the guards could notice me.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, or where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is. I could ask Sesk, Vosh-Leera or Heem-Jasa.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Vosh-Leera says this is more than a herald can judge, and paid me a hundred gold. I'm to go to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, at her house in Helstrom. Helstrom is far to the south through deadly country, so I'm to ride the rootworm, which the tree-minder calls at the Hist pool here. First I'm to ask Weeltul about it.
objectives: Ask Weeltul at Jal-Veesa's Hist pool about the rootworm to Helstrom. (marker: Weeltul)

plan.going: I am sent on to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, in Helstrom.
plan.next: Ask Weeltul at the Hist pool about the rootworm to Helstrom.
plan.ways: One way; the road on foot runs through deadly country.

answers: Vosh-Leera heard my report and paid me 100 gold. She says it is beyond a herald and sends me to Nesh-Deeka, the order handler in Helstrom.
Ask Weeltul at the Hist pool in Jal-Veesa about the rootworm ride to Helstrom, which costs 25 gold.
Ride the rootworm as told, or stay and trade with Heem-Jasa first. The road south is deadly, so riding seems wise.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is, who Nesh-Deeka is beyond handler, or what the Xeech-Leel council is. I could ask Nesh-Deeka or others in Helstrom.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Weeltul told me how the rootworm works: a great worm that swims the roots between the trees' pools, and she calls it for travellers at Jal-Veesa's pool. The fare to Helstrom is twenty-five gold, paid to her. I'm to pay her the fare, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka's House there.

plan.going: I know what the rootworm is, where to take it and what it costs.
plan.next: Pay Weeltul the fare, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka's House.

answers: I am Tarin, a thief freed by Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa, who serves the Toh-Reel-Ka. I picked the lock of Sesk's cage at Karsh-Naal Camp and gave Sesk her sack. She told me the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain Hist sap into jars and seal the scars with grey paste called the seal. The jars go on to the leader, and the sap goes into a draught tied to something called the Eye. Vosh-Leera heard this, paid me 100 gold, and said it is beyond a herald. She sent me to the order handler Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Pay Weeltul the 25 gold fare at the Hist pool in Jal-Veesa, ask her to call the rootworm, ride to Helstrom, and find Nesh-Deeka's house. The Helstrom rootworm caller can point the way.
I can ride the rootworm now, or first trade with Heem-Jasa for alchemy, sap, fungus and eggshells. I have about 150 gold, a lockpick, the Hist blessing and the Unbound note.
I still do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, why the Unbound drain and then seal the trees, or where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is. Nesh-Deeka or the Xeech-Leel council in Helstrom may know.
